name: ECI LLC
old_description: ECI LLC, (Electrical, Controls and Instrumentation was founded in 2017 by owner and operator Casey Hoskinson. ECI is a Wyoming Electrical Contractor based in Glenrock, Wyoming, specializing in Industrial electrical construction and Maintenance.
about:
ECI LLC, operating as Electrical Controls & Instrumentation, was founded in 2017 by owner-operator Casey Hoskinson in Glenrock, Wyoming. The company began as a Wyoming-licensed electrical contractor focused on industrial electrical construction and maintenance across the Rocky Mountain region.

The firm designs and builds UL 508A-listed industrial control panels in-house and provides a range of services including industrial electrical work, instrumentation, automation, telemetry and SCADA systems, electrical maintenance, commercial electrical, turnkey installations, and engineer-design drafting. Fabrication capabilities are tailored to withstand the region’s harsh climate. The team comprises master electricians, journeymen, apprentices, welder-fabricators, equipment operators, and engineer-drafting personnel. ECI holds electrical contractor licenses in Wyoming, Colorado, Texas, and North Dakota.

ECI serves the coal mining sector in the Powder River Basin, farming and agriculture operations in remote locations with limited utility service, and the oil and gas industry throughout the Rocky Mountains. Customers include industrial, commercial, and energy-sector clients requiring rugged electrical infrastructure.

The company emphasizes completing projects on time and under budget, with 24/7 on-call service availability. Its fabrication is engineered for the extremes of the Rocky Mountain environment, and the company cites craftsmanship and customer service as core differentiators.
